purpose: Give Mythical Void one complete, truthful first social release built around real gameplay and a live story destination.

selection.reason: Project Beacon explains the emotional centre of the game, links to a spoiler-light live page and can be shown with authentic running-build gameplay rather than generated marketing artwork.

professionalNetwork.copy:
The Project Beacon story is live

A new spoiler-light story page now explains the crash of Wanderer-77, first contact, six living realms and the choice waiting at the heart of Project Beacon.

• Six realm images come from the real running game.
• The page explains why the guardians are restored rather than destroyed.
• The ending remains for players to discover themselves.

See what changed: https://mythicalvoid.com/story/

Captured from the real browser game using an invented test state; no player information is shown.
